behavior: Brand logos for supported networks and tokens, footer social links that say Coming soon on hover, and custom Merchant and Freelancer icons
acceptance: Given the networks strip and token chips, then Base, USDC and USDT show their brand logos (from thesvg, MIT, credited); networks without a published logo keep their name only
Given the footer, then X, GitHub, Discord, Telegram and LinkedIn icons appear and show a Coming soon tooltip on hover and keyboard focus; they are not links yet
Given the profile tabs and the kit icon set, then Merchant and Freelancer use custom SVG icons drawn in the same 24px grid and 1.75 stroke as Lucide
notes: 2026-10-08 review pass by subagent: Pass. Checks: playwright 17/17 passed (incl. axe light/dark on / and /kit); ui-web vitest 14/14; pnpm lint clean (146 files); pnpm typecheck 3/3 ok. License: packages/ui-web/src/icons/LICENSE-thesvg.txt holds the MIT notice (thesvg.org) and brand-data.ts:1 credits it. dangerouslySetInnerHTML (brand-icon.tsx:17) only takes BRAND_ICONS[name] where name is keyof a const object; markup has no script or on* attributes. A11y (checked live on :3000): footer list 'Social channels' has 5 buttons named 'X|GitHub|Discord|Telegram|LinkedIn: Coming soon', aria-disabled, tabIndex 0, Enter does not navigate, tooltip role=tooltip 'Coming soon' appears on focus; BrandIcon without label is aria-hidden; custom icons aria-hidden; networks list still reads Base, Arbitrum, Arc, Tempo, USDC, USDT. Screenshots: logos crisp with brand colors in light and dark (Base blue square, USDC, USDT); social glyphs use currentColor; tooltip sits below the button and covers no text; tabs dark fine. Custom icons rendered at 120px next to Lucide: same 1.75 stroke and round caps. Non-blocking notes: (1) FreelancerIcon (custom-icons.tsx:36-41) reads more like a printer/receipt than a laptop, and its base line spans x 1.5-22.5, outside Lucide's 2px padding; (2) PaymentPathIcon docstring (custom-icons.tsx:44) says three stops but draws two circles and an arrowhead; (3) BRAND_ICONS title fields (brand-data.ts) are never read; (4) socials get both aria-label 'X: Coming soon' and tooltip aria-describedby 'Coming soon', so screen readers hear it twice.

2026-10-08 review pass by subagent: Re-review after fixes: pass. (1) FreelancerIcon (custom-icons.tsx:35-42) is now a laptop: rect 4,4 16x11.5, invoice lines, tick, base line 2.5-21.5 inside Lucide's 2px padding; updated f018-icons.png shows it reads as a laptop with an invoice, and stroke and size match the Lucide icons next to it. PaymentPathIcon comment (custom-icons.tsx:45) now matches the drawing. (2) site-footer.tsx social buttons use aria-label={social.name} and keep aria-disabled=true. Checked live on :3000 by pressing Tab from X to GitHub: the tooltip opens (role=tooltip, 'Coming soon'), aria-describedby points to it, and Chrome's accessibility tree reports name 'GitHub', description 'Coming soon', disabled true. Snapshot: list 'Social channels' with buttons X, GitHub, Discord, Telegram, LinkedIn, all disabled. pnpm --filter @forwend/web exec playwright test e2e/a11y.spec.ts: 4/4 passed (axe on / and /kit, light and dark). Note, not a defect: 'Coming soon' is only exposed while the tooltip is open (focus or hover), so in browse mode a screen reader hears 'GitHub, dimmed'; aria-disabled still says the button is unavailable. Earlier notes still open: BRAND_ICONS title fields in brand-data.ts are unused.
